inputs.name: LocalOperationsService.constructor.options
inputs.description: The two ports this window may use: `bridge` is the desktop bridge without `onRunEvent`, and `control` is the remote control port without `onStatus`. The constructor stores this object as given and checks neither port, so a missing method fails only when a request calls it.

inputs.name: LocalOperationsService.handle.request
inputs.description: A request envelope; `handle` reads only `method` and `input`, so `type` and `id` are never read here. It deletes `epoch` from a copy of `input`, then passes the rest unchecked to the control operations `approvePairing`, `denyPairing` and `revokeDevice`, which validate it themselves, calls the other control operations with no argument, and checks every other method's input against its bridge channel.

outputs.name: LocalOperationsService.methods
outputs.description: A new array holding every name in `remoteMethods`, in that order, on each call. It includes `session.attach`, which `handle` rejects because no bridge channel matches it.

outputs.name: LocalOperationsService.handle
outputs.description: The resolved value of the request: a control result for `remote.*` methods (`RemoteHostStatus`, or `RemotePairingOffer` from `remote.createPairing`), a `RemoteBinary` for `image` and `artifact`, and otherwise the bridge's own return value, unchanged.

errors.name: DesktopOperationUnavailableError
errors.description: The throws in `handle` reach the caller as rejected promises: `Desktop operation unavailable.` when the bridge lacks the operation, `Unknown desktop operation.` when a method has no bridge channel, and a validator's message when the input is refused. A rejection from a bridge or control operation passes through unchanged.

errors.name: UnexpectedOverviewFieldsError
errors.description: Project overview accepts no request fields after the protocol epoch is removed.
